name: Wren Alder
blurb: The first to stay when the lights went out. She kept one rushlight burning the whole time.

name: Old Bramble
blurb: Knows every channel in the fen, including the ones that weren't there yesterday.

name: Sorrel
blurb: Drawn back by the first lit window in years. Embroiders by lamplight and nothing else.

name: Ilsabet Vane
blurb: Once tended every lantern in the fen. She has a score to settle with the Lantern Thief.

name: Bodkin Harrow
blurb: Says an inn isn't an inn until someone's fallen asleep by the fire.

name: Pip Reedwhistle
blurb: Sells buttons, gossip and the occasional map of dubious accuracy.

name: Marigold Fen
blurb: Can't stand an empty oven. Or an empty stomach.

name: Wick
blurb: Small, bright and easily offended. Glows brighter when complimented.

name: Ottoline Brook
blurb: Laughs at everything, especially the weather.

name: Hazel Underbough
blurb: Has a remedy for everything and a strong opinion about the rest.

name: Dunstan Croak
blurb: Steeps his tea for exactly as long as the rain lasts.

name: Fennimore Quill
blurb: Writing a history of the fen. It's already eleven volumes and he's only reached last spring.

name: Nettle & Burr
blurb: They fix lanterns. Mostly. The ones they don't fix are now much more interesting.

name: Captain Cindral
blurb: Stands on one leg for hours and has never once lost a passenger. Or so she claims.

name: Aurelio Glasswing
blurb: Weaves cloth from moonlight and gossip in roughly equal parts.

name: Velvet
blurb: Remembers every guest's name, drink and secret.

name: Mother Sedge
blurb: Older than the fen itself. She remembers what the Lantern Thief looked like before the mask.

name: Sir Ember Ashlock
blurb: Carries a flame the Thief could never steal. Polite to a fault, even to frogs.
